svg.desc: Four failure rows: ranker error and ranker timeout fall back to popularity order; a feature-store outage uses default features; a retrieval failure serves a cached popular list. Each row lists its measured cost.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Graceful degradation: always return something sensible

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Healthy: p50 ≈ 5 ms, catalogue NDCG@10 0.72. Each failure has a cheaper fallback.
